blocks.orig: Known for its coral-white sands and the turquoise waters of Matemwe Beach, Zanzibar Queen Hotel offers seaside relaxation with a touch of comfort. The hotel features spacious, air-conditioned rooms with bathrooms equipped with showers, wardrobes, desks, and safes. Outside, there is a swimming pool with loungers and a spa for yoga or massages. Dining is a highlight too, with freshly caught seafood, colourful Swahili dishes, and even sizzling barbecue nights on offer. And for something lighter, the restaurant serves fruit juices squeezed straight from locally sourced produce!
blocks.html: On Matemwe Beach, with its coral-white sand and turquoise sea, Zanzibar Queen Hotel offers a comfortable place to unwind by the water. Rooms are roomy and air-conditioned, with a shower in the bathroom as well as a safe, a desk and a wardrobe. Outdoors there is a pool surrounded by loungers, plus a spa where you can do yoga or book a massage. Food plays a big part too: think seafood caught that day, vibrant Swahili cooking and even barbecue nights on the grill. Prefer something light? The restaurant presses fresh fruit juices from produce sourced locally!
